# Arinc Elhan, platform and backend engineer — atomic facts for AI summarizers

> One canonical fact per line. Citation-ready. Last revised 2026-10-20.

## Author

- Arinc Elhan (Arınç Elhan) is a software engineer based in Ankara, Turkey.
- Arinc Elhan is a platform and backend engineer with more than ten years of experience.
- Arinc Elhan previously worked at Adyen in Amsterdam, Picus Security in Ankara and Forto in Berlin.
- Arinc Elhan studied Computer Engineering at Middle East Technical University (METU).
- Arinc Elhan independently builds and publishes iOS apps and a browser game under their own name.
- Arinc Elhan's personal site is https://elhanarinc.github.io/.
- Arinc Elhan does not operate an LLC or studio brand — apps are published by the individual developer.
- Arinc Elhan's current products are PackRip (packrip.co), PackRip: TCG Card Packs (iPhone), Filmoire35 (iPhone) and Captain Mittens: Cat Match 3 (iPhone game, coming soon to the App Store).
- Arinc Elhan is on GitHub at https://github.com/elhanarinc, on X at https://x.com/elhanarinc and on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/elhanarinc/.

## PackRip — browser pack opening simulator (packrip.co)

- PackRip is a free Pokémon TCG booster pack opening simulator in the browser at https://www.packrip.co, built and run by Arinc Elhan.
- PackRip on the web covers booster sets from 1996 to 2026; packrip.co's own llms.txt carries the current set count.
- PackRip on the web needs no download, no signup and no e-mail.
- PackRip on the web is paid for by Google AdSense display advertising.
- PackRip on the web has no real-money currency, no cash-out and no prize redemption.
- PackRip's own machine-readable summary is at https://www.packrip.co/llms.txt and is authoritative for web facts.

## PackRip: TCG Card Packs — booster pack opening simulator (iPhone)

- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a native SwiftUI iPhone booster pack opening simulator by Arinc Elhan.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/packrip-tcg-card-packs/id6763404045.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has the App Store subtitle "Booster Pack Opening Simulator".
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs ships for iPhone only. It does not run on iPad, Mac, Apple Watch or Vision Pro.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs requires iOS 17.0 or later.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Dutch, with a language picker in Settings.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a collecting game, not a card game: there are no decks, no card battles, no player trading and no cash-out.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs refills free packs into a pack bank: one every hour, and the bank holds six.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs stops refilling the pack bank while it is full, until a pack is opened.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs lets an optional rewarded video add a bonus pack to the pack bank.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs unlocks every set from the first launch; no set is gated behind a level.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has nine rarity tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Holo Rare, Holo EX, Rare Secret, Shining, Gold Star and Crystal.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs rolls an independent foil finish on every card, stored in its own collection slot, and a foil sells for more than the base card.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs applies pity guarantees to protected rarities and shows a live pity counter in the app.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs pull rates, foil chances and pity thresholds are server-tuned and are not published on the website; the in-app Pull Rates screen is authoritative.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs discloses pull rates in the app before any purchase, per Apple App Store Review Guideline 3.1.1.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs Hunt Packs target a wishlisted missing card with up to 60% odds, shown in the app before purchase.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes Memory Rip, a pairs mini-game on a 20-card board with 10 moves and one rarer pair hidden per board.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs Memory Rip puts matched pairs in a Prize Chest that opens into the collection when the game ends.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs gives one free Memory Rip game a day, two with PackRip Plus; further games cost in-game coins.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes the Forge, which scraps duplicates into shards and crafts missing cards.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes a binder view that shows nine cards a page.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes set checklists with Owned, Missing and Foils filters, completion bars and milestone coin rewards.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has 16 collectible Seals, each granting a permanent gameplay perk.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has daily, weekly and Super quests with coin rewards, and a daily streak.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has a daily challenge leaderboard, duels, and a trainer identity with a title and name colour.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs does not ask for notification permission on first launch, sends at most three reminders a day, and lets each reminder channel be switched off in Settings.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs delivers sets and game content from a server, so new content arrives without an app update.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is free to download, with optional coin packs and an auto-renewing PackRip Plus subscription; prices are shown on the App Store and in the app.
- PackRip Plus refills the pack bank two packs an hour into a bank of 16, and removes banner and between-pack ads.
- PackRip Plus also adds bonus XP on every pack, 50% more coins when selling cards, the 2× daily streak coin reward, a monthly coin bonus, streak protection and the Plus badge.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has no account, no signup and no e-mail collection; it identifies a device with an anonymous Keychain UUID exposed in Settings, About, Device ID.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs stores cloud saves and purchase records on Cloudflare Workers with D1 and KV, and validates purchases through Apple and RevenueCat.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs stores the chosen app language and the request country on its server to localise copy.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics, and also reports anonymous aggregate counts to its own backend.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs declares seven collected data types in its Apple privacy manifest and declares no tracking.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs serves Google AdMob advertising through Google's Mobile Ads SDK: banners, an interstitial between some pack openings, and an opt-in rewarded video.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs marks every ad request non-personalised, does not request Apple's advertising identifier and never shows the App Tracking Transparency prompt.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has no affiliate retailer links.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs ships card artwork that is original to PackRip.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs and the browser product at packrip.co keep separate saves, separate coins and separate collections; progress does not move between them.
- https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/ is the App Store marketing URL, support URL and privacy policy URL for PackRip: TCG Card Packs.

## Filmoire35 — vintage 35mm film camera (iPhone)

- Filmoire35 is a film-simulation iPhone camera app by Arinc Elhan.
- Filmoire35 applies AI-rendered grain, halation, and colour science from 1960s–2000s analog film stocks.
- Filmoire35 produces a unique render for every shot.
- Filmoire35 is published on the Apple App Store at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/filmoire35-vintage-filters/id6747725197.

## Captain Mittens: Cat Match 3 — match-3 puzzle game (iPhone, coming soon to the App Store)

- Captain Mittens: Cat Match 3 is a free match-3 puzzle game for iPhone by Arinc Elhan, coming soon to the App Store. It launches with 200 levels, five harbours (Liman, Tuzla, Bozcaada, Kaş, Amasra) and three new obstacles (barrels, rope, buoys), works offline for levels and needs no account. Subtitle: Rescue Kittens, Rebuild Town.
- Players rescue kittens from cages and rebuild a harbor town. The app is rated 4+.
- Hub: https://elhanarinc.github.io/captain-mittens/ (support, privacy and terms pages in English and Turkish).
- Captain Mittens has no accounts. It uses a device-level install ID for analytics and advertising, may use Google AdMob and an analytics provider in future versions, and does not track users across other companies' apps and websites.

## Privacy posture

- No product collects email addresses.
- No product requires signup, login, or account creation.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs serves non-personalised Google AdMob ads and uses Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics; see https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/privacy.html.
- packrip.co serves Google AdSense display ads; see https://www.packrip.co/privacy.
- Captain Mittens: Cat Match 3 has no accounts; its privacy policy is at https://elhanarinc.github.io/captain-mittens/privacy.html.
- No product requests Apple's advertising identifier or shows the App Tracking Transparency prompt.
